evidence.title: NeuroPrefetcher: Storage-Aware Sparse LLM Inference via Delta Prefetching

summary: Researchers propose NeuroPrefetcher, a storage-aware method using delta prefetching to optimize sparse large language model inference. The technique aims to reduce latency and improve efficiency in memory-constrained environments.
title: NeuroPrefetcher Introduces Delta Prefetching for Efficient Sparse LLM Inference
